title: Band 9 Samples: What kinds of books do you read for pleasure? [Why/Why not?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 17 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 3 Test 2 question: “What kinds of books do you read for pleasure? [Why/Why not?]” Sample 1: Reading For Pleasure Female Male I am particularly fond of graphic novels and comic books, as they offer an engaging amalgamation of visual art and storytelling. The vibrant illustrations and captivating storylines enable me to momentarily escape from reality, indulging in the realms of fantasy and adventure. Sample 2: Reading For Pleasure Female Male I find myself drawn to the enchanting realm of manga, specifically the shonen and shojo categories. These action-packed and romance-filled comics keep me on the edge of my seat while also tugging at my heartstrings. The dynamic blend of compelling narratives, relatable characters, and mesmerizing artistry make manga an irresistible form of entertainment for me. Sample 3: Reading For Pleasure Female Male I predominantly enjoy delving into historical fiction books for leisure, as they offer a captivating blend of authentic historical events and creative storytelling. These novels enlighten me about bygone eras while simultaneously providing riveting character development and intriguing plotlines. Sample 4: Reading For Pleasure Female Male As an avid reader, I derive immense pleasure from perusing science fiction novels. The imaginative worlds and futuristic concepts presented in these books foster my curiosity and challenge me to think beyond the boundaries of our present reality. They act as a gateway to uncharted territories, sparking my creativity and intellectual growth. Sample 5: Reading For Pleasure Female Male For leisure reading, I find myself gravitating toward self-help and personal development books. These literary works not only provide practical advice for enhancing various aspects of my life but also foster introspection and self-awareness. They serve as a catalyst for personal growth, inspiring me to strive for continuous improvement. Sample 6: Not Reading For Pleasure Female Male I seldom read books for pleasure, as I find myself drawn to more interactive forms of entertainment, like video games or board games, which provide a more immersive and engaging experience. Moreover, they allow me to connect with friends and family, fostering a sense of camaraderie and shared enjoyment. Sample 7: Not Reading For Pleasure Female Male As a self-proclaimed cinephile, I tend to gravitate towards watching films or television series rather than reading books for pleasure. The visual and auditory components of this medium enable me to fully immerse myself in the narrative, whilst also providing a welcome respite from the daily grind. Sample 8: Not Reading For Pleasure Female Male While I acknowledge the myriad benefits of reading, I must confess that it’s not my cup of tea when it comes to leisure activities. Instead, I have a penchant for exploring culinary arts and experimenting with new recipes, which not only satiates my creative appetite but also allows me to share my passion with others. Sample 9: Not Reading For Pleasure Female Male Although I appreciate the allure of literature, I personally prefer to indulge in other pastimes, such as painting or hiking. These activities enable me to unwind and recharge, whilst also offering a more tangible sense of accomplishment and personal growth. Sample 10: Not Reading For Pleasure Female Male Although I recognize the power of the written word, I don’t often read books for leisure, as I take great pleasure in listening to podcasts and audiobooks. These formats allow me to multitask and absorb new information whilst engaging in activities such as jogging or commuting, thus maximizing my time and nurturing my intellectual curiosity.
